BackstoryDef.title: gravship colonist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised on a gravship. [PAWN_pronoun] received training to repair and maintain the ship's systems.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] didn't interact with anyone besides [PAWN_possessive] parents and the captain.

BackstoryDef.title: asteroid miner
BackstoryDef.description: [Pawn_nameDef]'s family owned an orbital mining fleet. When they weren't bartering with traders on the surface, they were moving between mineral-rich asteroids in orbit.\n\n[Pawn_nameDef] spent most of [PAWN_possessive] time hauling valuables to the gravship.

BackstoryDef.title: orbital pirate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by an orbital pirate gang. [PAWN_pronoun] was used as bait, pretending to be injured long enough for [PAWN_possessive] crew to ambush anyone who responded to the distress calls.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] took joy in watching them die.

BackstoryDef.title: medical student
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a satellite that offered medical services and ship repairs. [PAWN_pronoun] learned how to perform first aid and helped the surgeon with minor operations.

BackstoryDef.title: hydroponics farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised on a civilian garden vessel. [PAWN_possessive] formative years were spent tending to crops and learning to maintain the hydroponics system.\n\nThe ship's crew was small and lacked combat experience, so [PAWN_nameDef] had to help defend against raids.

BackstoryDef.title: lone survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the only survivor of a nasty plague. [PAWN_pronoun] drifted alone aboard a derelict gravship for months, living off of the dead crew's rations.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef]'s sculptures kept the loneliness at bay until an orbital trading ship found [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: galley porter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always dreamed of being a chef. As soon as [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to work, [PAWN_pronoun] took a job cleaning dishes and prepping vegetables in the galley.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] free time bantering with the other staff.
